name: Deuel
overview: The name Deuel, also rendered Reuel, is associated in Scripture with the leadership of the tribe of Gad. Specifically, Eliasaph is identified as the son of Deuel and serves as the prince and captain over the children of Gad, demonstrating a position of tribal authority and responsibility. These references emphasize the continuity of leadership within the tribe during the wilderness period as recorded in the book of Numbers.
